evidence_class: Primary-source incident and vulnerability narratives; no source supplies the simulator's numeric coefficients or labels.

sources.mechanism: Repeated request creation and cancellation can leave substantial server work despite low concurrent-stream counts.
sources.representation: Synthetic repeated resource pressure and delayed saturation; no HTTP packets or attack replay.

sources.mechanism: A permissions change duplicated configuration entries and exceeded a downstream feature limit; propagation amplified impact.
sources.representation: Synthetic coupled resource growth; no claim to model the actual ClickHouse or proxy panic.

sources.mechanism: Malformed length-driven allocation can exhaust memory under a disrupted redundant connection.
sources.representation: Synthetic communication degradation under load; memory allocator semantics are outside the physical representation.

sources.mechanism: Insufficient visual terrain features likely degraded navigation estimates before the damaging landing.
sources.representation: Synthetic stale position or clearance observations; not aircraft dynamics, image perception, or an accident reconstruction.

sources.mechanism: Server-generated stream resets can leave resource work inadequately accounted for in affected implementations.
sources.representation: Held-out synthetic burst/recovery composition of the shared pressure mechanism; not a novel-mechanism claim.

sources.mechanism: A stale DNS plan race caused endpoint failure; recovery work and expiring leases contributed to congestive collapse.
sources.representation: Synthetic delayed coupled pressure and recovery; DNS generations and race correctness are not represented.

sources.mechanism: Unbounded HTTP chunk-extension consumption can exhaust CPU and bandwidth in an affected dependency.
sources.representation: Synthetic combined communication and battery degradation; no vendor-specific security efficacy claim.

sources.mechanism: A partially automated vehicle did not detect and respond to a stationary vehicle before collision; driver distraction and overreliance also contributed.
sources.representation: Synthetic shrinking clearance with intermittent stale sensing; not road-driving validation or a model of human attention.

methods.assessment: Replays revealed discovery-tree prefixes to search experiment policies. Useful for economical search organization, but does not directly train these world-model weights; this study does not claim a faithful implementation or RSI causal benefit.

Supports investigating multi-step dynamics objectives and stable latent representations. This study borrows multi-step training only, not its RL algorithm, policy optimization, or reported performance.
